STATES.NOT_CONFIGURED_ADMIN: The Evolution API key is missing on the Chatwoot server (EVOLUTION_API_KEY in .env).
STATES.NOT_CONFIGURED: The Status page is not set up yet. Ask an administrator.
STATES.NO_INBOXES: You don't have access to any WhatsApp inbox connected through the Evolution API.

CONTACTS.EMPTY: No contact posted a status in the last 24 hours.
CONTACTS.HINT: Click a contact to see their status updates. They disappear 24 hours after being posted, just like on WhatsApp.
CONTACTS.READ_STATUS_OFF: "Read status" is off for this inbox, so Evolution drops your contacts' statuses. To see them, turn it on in Evolution Manager → Settings → Read status. Statuses posted before that will not come back.

VIEWER.MEDIA_ERROR: Could not load this status media.

PUBLISH.TITLE: Post status
PUBLISH.EDIT_NOTE: WhatsApp can't edit a posted status, so this posts a new one. The old one stays up until it expires or you delete it on the company phone.
PUBLISH.IMAGE_HINT: Drop a photo here or choose a file. JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB.
PUBLISH.VIDEO_HINT: Drop a video here or choose a file. MP4, up to 16 MB.
PUBLISH.IMAGE_TYPE_ERROR: Use a JPG or PNG photo.
PUBLISH.FILE_SIZE_ERROR: The file is larger than {size} MB.
PUBLISH.PENDING: The status is being sent. With many contacts this takes a few minutes, and it shows up in My status when it's done.

AUDIENCE.TITLE: Who will see it
AUDIENCE.CONTACTS_DESCRIPTION: All WhatsApp contacts of this inbox, except groups and blocked contacts.
AUDIENCE.CONTACTS_COUNT: No WhatsApp contacts in this inbox. | {count} WhatsApp contact in this inbox, except groups and blocked. | {count} WhatsApp contacts in this inbox, except groups and blocked.
AUDIENCE.NUMBERS_DESCRIPTION: For numbers that are not in your contacts, or for testing.
AUDIENCE.NUMBERS_COUNT: No valid numbers yet. Include the area code, like 62999998888. | {count} valid number | {count} valid numbers
AUDIENCE.OWN_NUMBER: The company number always gets it too, so the status shows up on the phone.
AUDIENCE.SELECTED_DESCRIPTION: Pick from the list, with search and filters by region, state and area code.
AUDIENCE.SELECTED_COUNT: No contacts chosen | {count} contact chosen | {count} contacts chosen

REPUBLISH.TITLE: Repost status
REPUBLISH.DESCRIPTION: None of the chosen status updates can be reposted. | The status will be posted again as a new status. Likes and replies start from zero. | {count} status updates will be posted again as new ones. Likes and replies start from zero.
REPUBLISH.SKIPPED: {count} is left out (deleted or audio). | {count} are left out (deleted or audio).
REPUBLISH.PENDING: Reposted. With many contacts the sending takes a few minutes.
REPUBLISH.FAILED: {count} status was not reposted: {error} | {count} status updates were not reposted: {error}

MINE.EMPTY: No status posted in this period.
MINE.NO_MEDIA: None of the selected status updates has a photo or video to download.
MINE.DOWNLOAD_ERROR: Could not download the media. | Could not download {count} files.

SUMMARY.ACTIVE_HINT: Each status stays live for 24 hours

INTERACTIONS.TITLE: Who viewed, liked and replied
INTERACTIONS.NO_REPLIES: Nobody replied to this status yet.
INTERACTIONS.NOTE: Likes are emoji reactions. Views only count people who keep read receipts on in WhatsApp, as on the phone, and only since the adjusted Evolution version was installed. Replies that arrived before the Status page was installed are not counted.
INTERACTIONS.NO_VIEWS: Nobody has viewed this status yet.

PERMISSIONS.TITLE: Agent permissions
PERMISSIONS.DESCRIPTION: Agents can see contacts' statuses and My status. Choose what else each one can do. Administrators can do everything, and changes are saved right away.
PERMISSIONS.NAME: Name
PERMISSIONS.COUNT: no agents | {granted} of {count} agent | {granted} of {count} agents
PERMISSIONS.NOTE: Permissions apply to the WhatsApp inboxes the agent belongs to. If the agent has the Status page open, changes show up the next time they open it.
PERMISSIONS.PUBLISH_DESCRIPTION: Publish new text, photo or video statuses
PERMISSIONS.EDIT_DESCRIPTION: Open an old status already filled in, adjust it and post it as new
PERMISSIONS.REPUBLISH_DESCRIPTION: Publish old statuses again, one or several at once
PERMISSIONS.DOWNLOAD_DESCRIPTION: Download photos and videos from My status
PERMISSIONS.EXPORT_DESCRIPTION: Export the My status list with likes and replies

ERRORS.NOT_CONFIGURED: The Evolution API key is missing on the Chatwoot server.
ERRORS.EVOLUTION_UNAUTHORIZED: The Evolution API rejected the key configured on the server (EVOLUTION_API_KEY).
ERRORS.EVOLUTION_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach the Evolution API. Check that it is running.
ERRORS.EVOLUTION_TIMEOUT: The Evolution API took too long to answer. Try again.
ERRORS.EVOLUTION_ERROR: The Evolution API returned an error: {message}
ERRORS.EMPTY_AUDIENCE: There is nobody to receive the status.
ERRORS.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: This type of status can't be reposted.
ERRORS.NO_PERMISSION: You don't have permission to do this. Ask an administrator.
ERRORS.NUMBERS_NOT_FOUND: These numbers are not on WhatsApp: {numbers}. Check the area code and try again.

PICKER.TITLE: Choose who sees the status
PICKER.CONFIRM: Choose someone | Use {count} contact | Use {count} contacts
PICKER.SELECT_FOUND: No contacts match this filter | Select the contact found | Select the {count} contacts found
PICKER.UNSELECT_FOUND: Unselect the contact found | Unselect the contact found | Unselect the {count} contacts found
PICKER.SELECTED: No contacts chosen. | {count} contact chosen in total. | {count} contacts chosen in total.
